title: Mearsurment of functional near-infrared spectroscopy signals in distracted drivers
author: Gongcheng Xu

steps_raw.instruction: Place the template at the corresponding positions of PFC, MC, and OC.
10 minutes for subjects to adapt to the driving simulator.
Use the calibration function of the instrument to ascertain the channels to fall exactly in correspondence of the 10/10 electrode positions.
Adjust the hair of the channel with low signal to noise ratio with a glass rod.
Make sure the signal is good and stable, and 5 minutes for subjects to rest.
20 minutes for subjects to maintain resting state.
20 minutes for subjects to perform staight driving.
20 minutes for subjects to perform straight driving with an audio task.
20 minutes for subjects to perform straight driving with an vigilance task.
